chmod 700 "$work"
cp -- "$archive" "$work/archive"
mkdir "$work/payload"

python3 - "$work/archive" <<'PY_EOF'
import posixpath
import sys
import tarfile

archive = sys.argv[1]
try:
    with tarfile.open(archive, mode="r:*") as package:
        seen = set()
        for member in package:
            name = member.name
            normalized = posixpath.normpath(name)
            if name.startswith("/"):
                raise ValueError(f"absolute member path: {name!r}")
            if ".." in name.split("/") or normalized == ".." or normalized.startswith("../"):
                raise ValueError(f"parent traversal in member path: {name!r}")
            if normalized in ("", "."):
                if member.isdir():
                    continue
                raise ValueError(f"invalid member path: {name!r}")
            if not (member.isdir() or member.isreg()):
                raise ValueError(f"non-file member is not allowed: {name!r}")
            if normalized in seen:
                raise ValueError(f"duplicate member path: {name!r}")
            seen.add(normalized)
except (tarfile.TarError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
    print(f"unpack: rejected archive: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
PY_EOF

tar --extract --file="$work/archive" --directory="$work/payload" \
    --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions --delay-directory-restore

    unsafe=$(find "$base/incoming" \( -type l -o \( ! -type d ! -type f \) -o \( -type f -links +1 \) \) -print -quit)

        printf 'unpack: unsafe existing destination entry: %s\n' "$unsafe" >&2
